a.lede: The automaker unveiled its next luxury sports car at an event in Texas. It has thrusters on it that can send it airborne.

b.lede: Last night, Elon Musk gave the people what they want: a car driving vertically up a multi-story ramp, launching off the edge, executing a mid-air "kickflip" over a lineup of Teslas, and landing via cold-gas thrusters.
